claims.statement: PASS: Provider identity resolution is internally supported. It names Aerodrome Finance/AERO and the contract, but the “Other” contract type does not establish Base attribution.
PASS: Values and UTC timestamps are explicit. Price × circulating supply = $928,958,574.35, consistent with reported $928,958,574 after rounding. Supply methodology remains unverified.
PASS: Recomputed from stored AERO endpoints: 7d 14.18099%, 14d 18.15181%, 21d 20.39468%; all agree with rounded statements. Only one market-data provider.

BLOCKED: The snapshot contains BTC/ETH percentage returns but no matching endpoint prices, so benchmark returns and relative-strength subtraction cannot be independently recomputed from retained observations. All three assets share CoinPaprika; this is single-provider evidence, not independent corroboration.

BLOCKED: Low/high numbers appear in stored summary, but the full 22-point series is absent, so the claimed extrema cannot be recomputed. Correctly caveated as sampled extrema, not technical support/resistance.
PASS: The reported 13.86% live ticker change and 14.18% 00:00 UTC endpoint return refer to different times/windows and are not intrinsically contradictory.

PASS: Pool and pair contract identifiers are explicit. Pool-detail reserve USD legs sum to the reported $47.25M TVL within rounding; turnover is distinguished from executable depth. Single DexPaprika origin.

PASS: Detail turnover / reported liquidity = 6.2172 for the cited cbBTC pool; pool search snapshot gives a slightly different volume/liquidity, so this ratio specifically uses the detail response. High ratio alone does not prove wash trading.
PASS: Correctly labeled CONFLICTED. Same pool ID returns ~$6.169M search liquidity and ~$7.501M detail liquidity; time/method alignment unresolved.
PASS: Spread = $0.0063; arithmetic midpoint = $0.92065; spread/midpoint = 0.68430%. Correctly limited to Crypto.com displayed CEX book and not Base DEX depth.
PASS: UNVERIFIED is appropriate; no trade-size quote or impact curve supports executable capacity.

FAIL: CORROBORATED is an unjustified upgrade under the contract because provider distinctness is observed but independent upstream provenance is not established (both upstream_provenance fields are absent / no source URLs). The contract-string match is useful but should be SINGLE_SOURCE pending source-independence verification; CoinPaprika itself does not establish chain.
PASS: UNVERIFIED is appropriate. Two GDELT calls returned 429 and no primary announcements were collected; absence of verified records does not establish no catalyst exists.

conflicts.description: The snapshot classifies a two-provider contract-string match as CORROBORATED, but distinct providers alone do not establish genuinely independent underlying origins. Recommend SINGLE_SOURCE unless upstream independence is evidenced.
BTC and ETH source observations retain calculated returns but not their endpoint prices; the market benchmark and excess-return calculations cannot be replayed from this snapshot.
AERO history observation retains extrema but omits the daily point series; extrema cannot be deterministically replayed.
